reviews.title: Misleading….No More Customized Meditations, Affirmations and Manifestations
reviews.text:
UPDATE: without warning or notification it stopped working and wanted me to pay $9.99 a month.    I don’t know why it worked 3 times then not at all. Feels bait and switch, at least give warning.  I expect more from Breathe.

ORIGINAL: I don’t write reviews often, but I truly love this app that made so many improvements that it’s not my favorite. They cannot do a customized meditation, affirmation, and manifestation that’s beautifully done with your specific needs and goals. It’s the best I’ve experienced and it’s currently a free feature even which is amazing. I’m telling everyone I know about this app. Thank you- it’s a life changer!

reviews.title: All audio is weird AI voice now
reviews.text: The app used to have human voices but it recently changed to all AI voices.   I don’t know why they changed it but I can no longer listen to any of it.  It’s super creepy.  It’s shame because they had good content.  Now some of hypnotherapy sessions are weird too.  I’m afraid to fall asleep to it anymore.

reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: Bought the lifetime pass when they were new.  Last night went in to use at 2am to find NOW they want annual subscription fee. Nice to learn at 2 am.  PLUS i already paid.  I came in early when nobody believed in you.  You used me now pull this.  Avoid.  All this is free as part of Spotify w no games

reviews.title: Worst app ever
reviews.text: I have not been meditating and it cursed me out I hate this app do not download ever in your life

reviews.title: Where are the twirling beads?!
reviews.text: This app shows twirling beads on the ad but only has audio on the app.

reviews.title: Downgraded
reviews.text: They changed this app so much! I used to have about 4 hrs of the unlocked ones saved to fall asleep to and they played back to back.  I only have ONE unlocked and there is no way to save more to play them one after the other anymore.
